newsitem.title: LATVIA: INVESTMENT BANK LAT BOND PROSPECTUS OKAYED.
newsitem.headline: INVESTMENT BANK LAT BOND PROSPECTUS OKAYED.

text.p: The Investment Bank said on Monday that the securities commission had approved the prospectus of its lat denominated one million lat bond issue.
"The securities commission today approved the prospectus of this issue but by law we can only release more details, including coupon size, later this week," a spokesman for the bank told Reuters.
He said that by law the information must be released to mass media simultaneously with its publication in the Latvijas Vestnesis, an official newspaper.
"This will be a matter of a few days," he said.
Investment Bank will the first local issuer of a lat denominated bond.
It will be available to both individuals and legal entities.
The bank earlier said the bond will be issued to finance investment projects.
The Investment Bank is an institution of the Latvian government and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD), which channels loans to medium and small-sized businesses.
The main sectors of the bank's activity in loans are timber exports and processing as well as food processing.
"There will definitely be more issues of this type," an Investment bank spokesman said.
Finland's Merita Bank in April became the first issuer of lat bonds with a two-year tap issue worth 15 million lats.
Merita bonds worth some 650,000 lats were sold on April 28 with a coupon of nine percent.
Latvia has few debt instruments at the moment but analysts say the market is set to take off and diversify.
